about: VNBox tuning options: URL params of boxedwine.html. Leave a param out to get its default. bool options are sent as urlValues[true|false]; int and choice options as the number. All are read once at startup (restart: the game has to be restarted for a change to apply). See docs/VNBox-Options.md.

options.name: nativeLibc
options.label: Native libc string functions
options.description: Runs hot C string and memory functions as browser code instead of emulated x86.

options.name: nativeAcm
options.label: Native vorbis.acm decoder
options.description: Decodes vorbis.acm background music as browser code instead of emulated x86.

options.name: nativeVorbis
options.label: Native libvorbis
options.description: Decodes a game's own libvorbis.dll audio as browser code instead of emulated x86.

options.name: nativeVorbisfile
options.label: Native libvorbisfile sample packing
options.description: Packs decoded audio into 16-bit samples as browser code instead of emulated x86, for a known libvorbisfile.dll build.

options.name: nativeFreetype
options.label: Native FreeType
options.description: Loads and draws Windows text glyphs (GDI fonts) as browser code instead of emulated x86.

options.name: nativeClock
options.label: Native clock reads
options.description: Reads QueryPerformanceCounter, timeGetTime and the system time as browser code instead of an emulated system call.

options.name: cheapGetMessage
options.label: Cheap message retrieval
options.description: GetMessage asks Wine's server only for the message itself, not twice more to reset and re-read its queue state.

options.name: nativeDibdrv
options.label: Native GDI drawing
options.description: Runs Wine's per-pixel GDI drawing into bitmaps (text, fills, blits, blends) as browser code instead of emulated x86.

options.name: nativeDsound
options.label: Native sound mixing
options.description: Runs Wine's DirectSound per-sample mixing (sample conversion, volume, mixing into the output) as browser code instead of emulated x86. Same output, no latency change.

options.name: nativeGlyphMetrics
options.label: Native text measuring
options.description: Answers Wine's cached text measuring (text extents, glyph metrics) as browser code instead of emulated x86.

options.name: nativeTextureUpload
options.label: Native texture upload
options.description: Converts BGRA and BGRX texture uploads to the browser's RGBA as browser code instead of emulated x86.

options.name: cheapFxsave
options.label: Cheap FPU state save
options.description: Saves and restores the FPU/SSE state (FXSAVE/FXRSTOR, done on every Wine system call) in one step instead of field by field. Same results.

options.name: nativeMutex
options.label: Native mutexes
options.description: Takes and releases uncontended Linux-side locks (Wine's font, GDI and window locks) as browser code instead of emulated x86.

options.name: cheapSpi
options.label: Cached system metrics
options.description: SystemParametersInfo's window metrics are built once and reused until a setting or font changes, instead of measuring three fonts on every call.

options.name: cheapAsyncKey
options.label: Cheap key polling
options.description: GetAsyncKeyState and other input checks read Wine's queue state once per call, not four times; input is seen just as soon.

options.name: hotGroup
options.label: Hot code groups
options.description: Compiles code that runs hot together into one module, so it runs faster.

options.name: jitInline
options.label: Inline small calls
options.description: Compiles calls to small functions into the code that calls them, so a call and its return cost no jumps between compiled blocks.

options.name: cheapHop
options.label: Cheaper block jumps
options.description: Jumps between compiled blocks read the next block through the address they already hold instead of loading it again for every check.

options.name: fastX87
options.label: Fast x87 maths
options.description: How the JIT keeps x87 floating point state: 1 is faster with the same results, 2 skips checks and may break games.

options.name: zeroPageTables
options.label: Zero page tables
options.description: Memory page tables only touch the pages a game uses, which saves memory.

options.name: hostWined3d
options.label: Native Direct3D (wined3d)
options.description: Runs Wine's Direct3D layer as browser code; only in builds made with HOST_WINED3D=1.

options.name: idleWait
options.label: Longest idle wait (ms)
options.description: Longest the engine sleeps while the game waits and no timer is due sooner; higher saves CPU, lower reacts faster.

options.name: fps
options.label: Frame rate cap
options.description: Most frames shown per second; lower saves CPU and battery, 0 shows every frame.

options.name: fitWindow
options.label: Fit game window
options.description: The game's main window fills the screen without a title bar.

options.name: movies
options.label: Play movies
options.description: Plays the game's MPEG-1 movies in the page; off leaves them to the game, which usually skips them.

options.name: disableHideCursor
options.label: Always show mouse pointer
options.description: Shows the browser arrow where the game hides its cursor; off hides it as the game asks.

options.name: animatedCursors
options.label: Animated cursors
options.description: Plays a game's animated mouse cursor frame by frame, as on Windows; off shows its first frame only.

options.name: audioPeriod
options.label: Audio buffer (frames)
options.description: Frames per audio callback when the audio worklet is not used, rounded down to a power of two; higher stutters less but lags more.

options.name: stats
options.label: Performance stats
options.description: Logs frame pacing, drawing, timer and JIT counters to the console every 2 seconds.

options.name: prof
options.label: Guest code profiler
options.description: Samples where guest time goes, per module and offset, and logs it.

options.name: hotEntries
options.label: Hot group threshold
options.description: Entries per period that make a block hot for hot code groups (measurement only).

options.name: hotWaitMs
options.label: Hot group wait (ms)
options.description: Length of one hot code group period, after which the hot blocks are compiled together (measurement only).

options.name: hotMax
options.label: Hot group size
options.description: Most blocks queued for one hot code group (measurement only).
